title: One shift step on a nonempty gate list
statement: Let $n,m$ be natural numbers, let $g$ be an algebraic gate on $n$ variables, and let $g_s$ be a finite list of such gates; let $o$ be any bit string. Applying one shift step to the pairing of the unary string of length $m$ with the encoding of $g :: g_s$ paired with $o$ yields the pairing of that same unary string with the encoding of $g_s$ paired with $o$ followed by the bit $1$ and the encoding of $g$ with all node references shifted by $m$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite list of gates $g_s$ on $n$ variables
